## Core Competencies & Agency Capabilities
- **Frontend & Modern SSR**: React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP (GreenSock) 60FPS fluid motion, WCAG accessible semantics, zero CLS design.
- **UI/UX & Product Design**: Modern Figma design systems, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes, brand guidelines, mobile-first ergonomics.
- **Social Media & Growth**: Content creation, audience engagement, social branding, visual campaign production across Instagram and digital channels.
- **Backend & Core Runtimes**: Zero-dependency Native Node.js core microservices (`http`, `crypto`, `fs`), Vercel Edge functions, idempotent webhook processing, real-time Kitchen Display Systems (KDS).
- **Data & In-Memory Caching**: Upstash Redis REST KV engine (<10ms global edge latency), Redis Sorted Sets, PostgreSQL relational databases, connection pooling.
- **Security & Privacy**: HMAC-SHA256 request authentication, anti-replay tokens, replay-resistant payment consumers, statutory adherence to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023).
